title: Invented Analytical Fallbacks
description: NEVER create analytical approximations, estimated coefficients, or invented fallback code paths when the correct implementation exists in UE5 source. Examples of violations: inventing SH irradiance ratios (0.7, 0.8, 1.0) instead of reading cubemap, adding minimum clamps like max(value, 0.15), adding compensation factors like intensity * 1.5, guessing fog parameters instead of reading UE5 InitFogConstants.
whenToUse: Always check for this anti-pattern before committing any rendering, lighting, fog, shadow, or physics code.
whenNotToUse: N/A — this is always an anti-pattern. There are no exceptions.
